name: v2.05
description: v2.04 + a lower price-loss weight (one change): w_price 0.25 with w_trend 1 (was 1 : 1). Everything else exactly as v2.04, including news-robust training (p 0.2, whole window). Siwat, 2026-10-27, after v2.04 was adopted: in v2.03 the price task made ~80% of the training-loss drop (4.2x the trend's) and its hold-out error rises from epoch 1; E11b (price loss removed, older architecture) gained +0.007 / +0.017 / +0.009. The proposal requires a trained price head, so the weight is lowered, not set to 0.
decided: Siwat, 2026-10-27 10:25-10:35 (multiple choice: w_price 0.25 'equal pull'; adopt rule 'trend up, price not worse'; gradient diagnostic on)

protocol.split: official 70/15/15 by date (validation only; test sealed)
protocol.labels: k x sigma_h fitted on training rows (k = 0.307 / 0.318 / 0.324 on the official split)

run.gpu: Colab only (Linux; ADX tie rule, claude/log-entry-2026-10-27-adx-tie-platform.md). Seeds one after another (parallel gave no speed-up).

_notes.seeds: 4539913 / 9574315 / 2253758, chosen by Siwat 2026-10-20, replacing 20261015 / 16 / 17 used by E00-E31 and v2 (so runs are no longer paired seed-for-seed with those).
_notes.fixed: price_channels, sentiment, stock_identity: slide 9. indicators: proposal scope 2. pooling mean, scale_fusion attention: slides 11 and 19. trunk_width 128 and head_hidden 128/64: slides 12-13. price_target log_return: slide 9 and hard rule 1. horizons 1/5/10: proposal scope 4. protocol: earlier pre-registered decisions.
_notes.patches: 2 / 5 / 21, stride = length (the 2026-10-19 rule kept; not re-asked). Look-back 126: tokens 63 / 25 / 6; the 2-day and month scales cover all 126 days, the week scale skips the oldest day.
_notes.sma_ema_200: Computed from each stock's full past history, not the 126-day window; about 2.4% of sample rows are filled with the training mean.
_notes.encoder_norm: batchnorm = PatchTST's own encoder layer (post-norm, GELU, attention dropout 0), src/encoders.py.
_notes.stock_id_dropout: probability that a training row's stock_id is replaced by 'unknown' (0); stocks with no training rows always use 'unknown'.
_notes.sma_ema_60: Period 60 leaves 0.15% of training rows gap-filled with the training mean (measured 2026-10-25); period 200 left 2.7%.
_notes.training: Constant learning rate 1e-4 (v2.01). Kept epoch = best 3-horizon mean macro-F1 of the EMA weights (v2.01's rule); training stops 5 epochs after that best, or at 30 epochs (Siwat answered both 'v2.01: F1 + early stop' and '30 epochs'; read as early stopping with a 30-epoch cap). EMA of the weights, decay 0.99, ~172 steps per epoch at batch 256, so it averages ~100 steps, about 0.6 epoch; BatchNorm recomputed for the EMA weights; only EMA weights scored, kept and saved.
_notes.report: The average of the 3 seeds' probabilities is reported alongside the per-seed mean +- std, which stays the headline.
_notes.inner hold-out: protocol.inner_es_share 0.10 and purge 10 chosen by Siwat on 2026-10-25 (before that they were Claude's 2026-10-15 defaults).
_notes.why: v2.02 seed 4539913 (A100, 2026-10-25): hold-out macro-F1 rose to 0.379 at epoch 7 and held near 0.375, but hold-out cross-entropy was lowest at epoch 2 (1.0947) and rose to 1.118, above the uniform guess ln 3 = 1.0986 from epoch 6, so the CE-gated rule kept epoch 2 (F1 0.350); validation 0.316 / 0.357 / 0.347. Run stopped by Siwat after seed 1.
_notes.news_blank: Training windows only: hold-out (epoch choice) and validation are scored with the news as it is. Unit = the whole 126-day window (as 2026 without news, or a crawl outage). Own random stream (seed + 3), so with p = 0 training is exactly v2.03's. BatchNorm statistics of the EMA weights are recomputed with the same blanking rate on a fixed mask (seed + 4). Padding days (before a segment starts) stay 0.
_notes.adopt_rule: Pre-registered (Siwat, 2026-10-27, 'trend up, price not worse'), judged on the raw models vs v2.04: (a) validation, news on: v2.05's 3-horizon mean macro-F1 (seed mean) above v2.04's 0.3601; (b) price R2_OS (seed mean, mean of the 3 horizons) not below v2.04's -0.0343; (c) guard for v2.04's gain: validation, news blanked: the paired 95% date-block interval of v2.05 - v2.04 (3-horizon mean) is not entirely below 0. All three -> adopted. ts + blend reported beside it; 2026 reported only.
_notes.post_hoc: Scored with ts + blend (w on 0, 0.1, ..., 1, fitted on v2.04's own inner hold-out), raw and XGBoost alone beside (Siwat, 2026-10-27).
_notes.w_price: 0.25 = 'equal pull': with v2.03's loss drops (price 4.2x trend), the price task would make about half of what the shared layers learn (4.2w / (1 + 4.2w) = 51%) instead of ~80%. With AdamW the price head's own weights learn at nearly the same speed whatever w is (Adam steps are invariant to the gradient's scale; Kingma & Ba 2015), so w mainly sets the price task's pull on the shared layers. [Uncertainty Flag: the 51% assumes v2.03-like loss dynamics; the gradient diagnostic measures the real share.]
_notes.grad_diagnostics: Before training and after every epoch: gradient of each task's loss on the shared layers (all but the two heads), on 1,024 fixed fit rows, eval mode, no .grad, BatchNorm or random state touched (tests/test_grad_diag.py: training identical with it on or off). Logged: both norms, the price share of the weighted pull, and the cosine between the two gradients.
